numerical_failure.observed_behavior: With boundary_conditions="periodic" the returned eigenvectors contain duplicates, so eigenvectors() @ diag(eigenvalues()) @ eigenvectors().T does not recover lap.toarray(); the np.allclose assertion fails with AssertionError. For n=6 the printed eigenvector matrix has repeated columns (e.g. rows 0.289/-0.577 repeated).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The eigenvectors should be correct periodic-boundary Laplacian eigenvectors (following the Wikipedia periodic boundary conditions reference), so the full eigendecomposition reconstructs lap.toarray() and the eigenvectors are orthogonal (no duplicate eigenvectors).
trigger_conditions: one-dimensional grid with even n (example uses grid_shape=(6,))
eigenvectors computed via _ev1d for the periodic case with j+1 not equal to n

numerical_characteristics.tolerance: atol is used in test_eigenvectors assert_allclose calls (value not stated in passages)
category_specific_evidence: Bug is periodic eigenvectors of sparse.linalg.LaplacianNd; the eigenvector formula for periodic boundary conditions was wrong (old code used cos(2pi(k+0.5)/n * floor((j+1)/2)), new code uses sin(pi(k+0.5)/n*(j+1)) for even j+1 and cos(pi(k+0.5)/n*j) otherwise)

Violated property: full eigendecomposition L = V diag(w) V^T should recover lap.toarray(); the PR example printed eigenvectors whose product with diag(eigenvalues) and transpose did not match toarray(), raising AssertionError
Orthogonality property tested: eigenvectors @ eigenvectors.T should equal identity (np.eye(n)) within atol
Eigenvector normalization factor sqrt(2/n) and sqrt(1/n) for constant/alternating modes; values smaller than machine eps (np.finfo(np.float64).eps) are set to exact zero
Test modified so that the full eigendecomposition is checked against lap.toarray() with assert_allclose
Fix follows the Wikipedia reference for periodic boundary conditions of the second derivative eigenvectors
reproduction_risks: Reproduction requires LaplacianNd with boundary_conditions='periodic' and grid shapes such as (6,) or (2,3)
The tolerance atol value is not stated in the passages
Exact numerical expected values for the correct eigenvectors are not given beyond the printed example matrix, which was shown with rounded values (e.g. 0.408, 0.289)
